title: Dev Tools Reverse Engineering
features:
A dynamic, all-in-one penetration testing and reverse engineering suite for Roblox.Note: This tool is currently in its BETA phase. Features are continuously being optimized, and new dynamic analysis capabilities are actively in development.

🛠️ Core Features & Capabilities
📡 1. Advanced Remote SpyNetwork Interception: Log and analyze all outgoing RemoteEvent and RemoteFunction calls.  Auto-Decompiler: Automatically generate executable scripts (FireServer/InvokeServer) with formatted arguments on the fly.  Call Grouping: Group identical remote calls with a counter to prevent UI clutter and lag. 
 🌐 2. HTTP Traffic Monitor (HTTP Spy)Request Logging: Track all outgoing HttpGet, HttpPost, and executor-specific HTTP requests.  Webhook Blocker: Automatically block potentially malicious requests containing 'webhook' or 'websec'.  Traffic Control: Pause the logger or forcefully block all outgoing HTTP traffic to prevent data leaks.
  🖱️ 3. UI Automation & Inspector (UI Spy)Click Tracker: Log the exact path and attributes of any UI button clicked by the player.  Live UI Inspector: Click on any UI element on your screen to instantly dump its specific tree structure.  Full Tree Dumper: Dump the entire active GUI hierarchy (including hidden elements) to locate specific buttons and values.  
🌍 4. Spatial & World ToolsPosition Logger: Instantly copy your character's CFrame or locate the nearest entity (e.g., monster) and copy its coordinates.  Interaction Scanner: Scan the entire Workspace for all TouchTransmitter (TouchInterests) and ProximityPrompt objects.  
👁️ 5. ESP VisualizerObject Highlighting: Draw ESP boxes and BillboardGui labels on interactable world objects (TouchInterests and Prompts).  Target Filtering: Choose to highlight specific interaction types or visualize all of them simultaneously.  
🛡️ 6. Network FilteringAuto-Block Spam: Automatically filter and block remote calls that are spamming the network.  Granular Exclusions: Exclude specific remote names or instances from being tracked in your logs.  Firewall: Forcefully block specific remotes from communicating with the server entirely.  
🪝 7. Metatable Spoofing (Meta Hook)Read Interception (__index): Bypass anti-cheats by feeding them fake values when they try to read local properties (e.g., spoofing WalkSpeed).  Write Blocking (__newindex): Prevent server scripts or anti-cheats from modifying your client-side properties.  
🧠 8. Memory ScannerFunction Dumper: Scan the garbage collector to find specific functions in memory, extracting their hidden upvalues and constants.  Module Scanner: Dump a list of all active ModuleScripts currently loaded in the game's memory.  
💻 9. Console TrackerIn-Game Log Capture: Track, display, and copy all client-side Roblox Developer Console logs (Warnings, Errors, Info) directly inside the tool.
